source: Particle Data Group (S. Navas et al.), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024). Summary Tables PDFs: rpp2024-sum-leptons.pdf, rpp2024-sum-quarks.pdf, rpp2024-sum-gauge-higgs-bosons.pdf. Retrieved 2026-03-17.

target_definition.leptons: m_e, m_mu, m_tau from PDG 2024 leptons summary table.
target_definition.quarks: m_u, m_d, m_s are MSbar masses at mu=2 GeV; m_c and m_b are MSbar masses renormalized at mu=m; m_t is direct measurement (event kinematics), per PDG 2024 quarks summary table.
target_definition.gauge_higgs: m_W world average and m_Z Breit-Wigner parameter from PDG 2024 gauge & Higgs summary table; m_H from the same table.
